cradle.direction: whole cradle straight down in print frame after lifting from bed
cradle.method: Every actual cradle bead swept past the cumulative XY envelope of every carrier bead in the same or any lower layer. Conservative outward-rounded AABB rejection; exact clipped polygon intersection on every possible conflict tile, 0.15 mm centre-step guard, circumscribed bead widths. No thermal or force inference.

front_shelf.method: Every shelf bead against complete infinite horizontal obstacle shadows on all overlapping native height intervals. Circumscribed footprints include the 0.15-mm sample-step guard; outward-rounded AABBs reject only impossible conflicts, exact clipped convex sweeps confirm all candidate tiles.

rear_shelf.method: Every shelf bead against complete infinite horizontal obstacle shadows on all overlapping native height intervals. Circumscribed footprints include the 0.15-mm sample-step guard; outward-rounded AABBs reject only impossible conflicts, exact clipped convex sweeps confirm all candidate tiles.
